title: Manuscript Leaf with the Holy Trinity in an Initial T, from a Missal
author: South German, ca. 1390
museum: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 55.18.5 (Gift of Harry G. Friedman, 1955)
notes: Cropped to the painted initial (the T in gold on blue, its red frame); the vellum outside the paint made transparent with a soft edge.

title: Manuscript Leaf with the Trinity in an Initial T, from an Antiphonary
author: Master of the Riccardiana Lactantius, Italian, second half 15th century
museum: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 96.32.6 (Gift of Louis L. Lorillard, 1896)
notes: A blank stretch of the leaf's lower margin, flattened (divided by its own blur) and made seamless, used as a faint multiply texture.
